description: This file contains shell script tests mainly for verifying the behavior of 'git log' with various pathspecs, refs, and edge cases, used for testing Git's command-line handling of pathspec magic and ambiguity.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to succeed. Takes a description and a command sequence.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, used for testing error cases.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches the standard error output for a pattern.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets up cleanup commands to run after tests.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with optional parameters.
